0.content: **Node & Host view**: Aerospike latency, throughput and migrations next to the host's CPU, memory, disk and network, per node. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

1.content:
Note: this dashboard requires Node-Exporter deployed in the same host where the aerospike server and aerospike-prometheus-exporter are running. 

If aerospike-prometheus-exporter and node-exporter are running as different jobs in prometheus.yml configuration, user need to select both the jobs to see the data.

3.title: Client Reads (TPS) (TopK)
3.query:
timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_namespace_client_read_success, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a1 = sum(aerospike_namespace_client_read_timeout, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a2 = sum(aerospike_namespace_client_read_error, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a3 = sum(aerospike_namespace_client_read_not_found, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a4 = sum(aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_success, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a5 = sum(aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_error, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a6 = sum(aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_timeout, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a7 = sum(aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_not_found, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), by: { cluster_name, ns, service, storage_engine }
| fieldsAdd value = (((((((a0[] + a1[]) + a2[]) + a3[]) + a4[]) + a5[]) + a6[]) + a7[])
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7
| sort arrayAvg(value) desc
| limit 10
| fieldsRename total = value
| append [
  timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_namespace_client_read_error, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a1 = sum(aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_error, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), by: { cluster_name, ns, service, storage_engine }
  | fieldsAdd value = (a0[] + a1[])
  | fieldsRemove a0, a1
  | sort arrayAvg(value) desc
  | limit 10
  | fieldsRename error = value
]
| append [
  timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_namespace_client_read_timeout, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a1 = sum(aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_timeout, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), by: { cluster_name, ns, service, storage_engine }
  | fieldsAdd value = (a0[] + a1[])
  | fieldsRemove a0, a1
  | sort arrayAvg(value) desc
  | limit 10
  | fieldsRename timeout = value
]
| append [
  timeseries a0 = sum(aerospike_namespace_client_read_not_found, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), a1 = sum(aerospike_namespace_batch_sub_read_not_found, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) and in(service, array($node)) and in(ns, array($namespace)) }, rate: 1s), by: { cluster_name, ns, service, storage_engine }
  | fieldsAdd value = (a0[] + a1[])
  | fieldsRemove a0, a1
  | sort arrayAvg(value) desc
  | limit 10
  | fieldsRename not_found = value
]

9.content:
### Host Disk Read/Write Latency (Rate)

_Not available in Dynatrace yet ('and' between series). The equivalent Prometheus query:_

```promql
topk($topk_limit, (rate(node_disk_write_time_seconds_total{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) and rate(node_disk_writes_completed_total{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0))
topk($topk_limit, (rate(node_disk_read_time_seconds_total{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval])  and rate(node_disk_reads_completed_total{job=~"$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]) > 0 ))
```

15.title: Host Memory Page Faults (Rate)
15.query:
timeseries a0 = avg(node_vmstat_pgfault, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) }), a1 = avg(node_vmstat_pgmajfault, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) }), a2 = avg(node_vmstat_pgfault, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) }), a3 = avg(node_vmstat_pgmajfault, filter: { in(cluster_name, array($cluster)) }), by: { cluster_name, `service.instance.id` }
| fieldsAdd a0 = arrayDelta(a0)
| fieldsAdd a0 = a0[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd a1 = arrayDelta(a1)
| fieldsAdd a1 = a1[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd a2 = arrayDelta(a2)
| fieldsAdd a2 = a2[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd a3 = arrayDelta(a3)
| fieldsAdd a3 = a3[] / (interval / 1s)
| fieldsAdd pgfault = a0[], pgmajfault = a1[], pgminfault = (a2[] - a3[])
| fieldsRemove a0, a1, a2, a3

| fieldsRemove a0, a1
